question: Why the original makes 4 to 8 trade-roll draws an hour where OpenHOI3 made about 180.

addresses.name: CCountry::RunHourlyAITrade
addresses.evidence: The slice read on the listing at RunHourlyPass 0x28297B-0x2829D9 and the body at 0x27B160; on the running game, every trade-roll draw of 48 hours logged with its country by probes/hoidraws.lua - each country in one hour of the day, ENG and GER at 0:00, SOV USA JAP FRA at 1:00, ITA DEN at 2:00, the list's order with the null country first. What would show it wrong: a country drawing its trade roll in two hours of one day.

addresses.name: ProcessAITradeFunctor::operator()
addresses.comment: The per-country body the hourly AI trade functor runs; its only caller is 0x28EEA3 inside ProcessAITradeFunctor_start_for::execute (0x28EDE0), which is a TBB task vtable slot and so has no direct caller. It calls CCountry::RunHourlyAITrade (0xDC410) at 0x27B1A2. The name follows FINDINGS-tick's naming of 0x28E190; **read whole 2026-11-16** (0x27B160 to its `ret`): for each index from the range's begin to its end, the country (the list at [[this]], [eax + index*4]) is passed over where its tag (+0xCA4) is `REB` or it owns nothing (NumberOfOwnedProvinces +0xCF8 not above 0), else CCountry::RunHourlyAITrade(country). The range is a 24th of the countries by the hour of the day (SpawnProcessAITradeParallelFor), so each trades once a day (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 104). Signature corrected 2026-10-02 by the signature audit (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-sigaudit.md).

addresses.name: SpawnProcessAITradeParallelFor
addresses.comment: 0x28E190 to the bare `ret` at 0x28E269. Writes the start_for vftable 0x15CF70C at 0x28E20E (`start_for<blocked_range<I>, ProcessAITradeFunctor, auto_partitioner>`). One caller, RunHourlyPass at 0x2829DC - and RunHourlyPass sets the ai_pass_done latch immediately afterwards, at 0x2829E4. So AI *trade* runs every hour, a separate fan-out from the AI proper - **but over a 24th of the countries each hour**: RunHourlyPass gives the fan-out a 24th of the countries (0x28297B-0x2829D9): n = count / 24 (signed, by 0x2AAAAAAB), begin = n x g_CurrentHourOfDay, end = begin + n, and at hour 23 end = count - the remainder going to the last hour; count is the countries' list, the null country first (102 in Their Finest Hour: four an hour, ten at 23:00). Each country trades once a day (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 104). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-aisched.md.
addresses.evidence: The range's three dwords built at 0x28297B-0x2829D9 from the country count, 0x2AAAAAAB and g_CurrentHourOfDay; the trading seen on the running game once a day per country.
